verdict.rationale: GrowthBook lists "Safe rollouts" as a Pro-tier feature and supports guardrail metrics computed from warehouse data, so metric-guarded releases are plausibly covered. The pack never describes how safe rollouts monitor regressions or whether they roll back automatically; the evidence is only a pricing bullet plus guardrail metrics in the experiment context. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic regression detection and rollback behavior, details of how safe rollouts work, and any hands-on corroboration.
